name: fact_picker_u50
written: 2026-11-14 evening ET, before the picker ran with the price cap on any week (live or past)
why: operator 11/14: only pick stocks whose current price is $50 or less. This is the operator's preference for what he wants to hold; it does not come from a result (the first record had three picks and one day of prices).
what_changes: ONE thing, relative to docs/studies/fact_picker_prereg.json: a name is on the sheet only if its last close before the run is $50.00 or less. The cap is applied before the 100-name cut, so the sheet is the 100 most-mentioned names at or under $50. Everything else (sheet figures, prompt wording, both agents, mean score, top 3 / bottom 3 / 3 random, the 20-name minimum, the nightly catch-up, the operating rules) is unchanged.
new_record: Because the pool changed, this is a new test with new ledgers: ~/pick_ledgers/facts_u50 (picks), facts_u50_avoid, facts_u50_random. The first record (~/pick_ledgers/facts: LLY, REGN, GOOG, recorded 2026-11-12) receives no more picks; by its own rule it ends UNPROVEN (3 of 30 picks), neither a pass nor a fail. Its three paper positions are held to their 21st session and sold as planned.
verdict: the same single read as fact_picker_prereg.json, on the first 30 picks of facts_u50 at 21 sessions: every pick_ledger pass condition, t >= 2.5 clustered by entry week, and a mean vs SPY above the whole-sheet control (here the whole sheet is the capped sheet). Anything else = FAIL. Fewer than 30 picks by 2027-11-11, or switched off before the read = UNPROVEN.
what_the_cap_does_to_the_evidence: The stock list is names at $10 or more, so the pool becomes $10-$50 names: on average smaller and more volatile than the full list. A pass or fail here says nothing about names above $50. The whole-sheet control is drawn from the same capped pool, so the comparison stays fair.
replay: A screen on the twelve past Mondays may be recomputed from the SAVED agent scores (no new agent calls): keep only names at or under $50 at each Monday's prior close, then take the top 3 / bottom 3 / 3 random as usual. It is weaker than the first replay: the agents scored those names on an uncapped sheet, the weeks have now been looked at twice, and the earlier caveats (training leakage, list frozen after the period, adjusted prices) all stand. It changes nothing in the live rule.
paper_positions: tools/pick_positions.py buys the facts_u50 picks on paper by the same rule as before (equity / 15 per pick, entry day only, sold after 21 sessions). A display, not the test.
